--model-path.help: The path of the model weights. This can be a local folder or a Hugging Face repo ID.

--served-model-name.help: Override the model name returned by the v1/models endpoint in OpenAI API server.

--host.help: The host of the HTTP server.

--port.help: The port of the HTTP server.

--config.help: Read CLI options from a config file. Must be a YAML file with configuration options.

--api-key.help: Set API key of the server. It is also used in the OpenAI API compatible server.

--trust-remote-code.help: Whether or not to allow for custom models defined on the Hub in their own modeling files.

--tool-call-parser.help: Specify the parser for handling tool-call interactions. Use 'auto' to detect from chat template. Options include: ['apertus2509', 'cohere_command4', 'deepseekv3', 'deepseekv31', 'deepseekv32', 'deepseekv4', 'glm', 'glm45', 'glm47', 'gpt-oss', 'kimi_k2', 'lfm2', 'llama3', 'mimo', 'minicpm5', 'mistral', 'poolside_v1', 'pythonic', 'qwen', 'qwen25', 'qwen3_coder', 'step3', 'step3p5', 'minimax-m2', 'trinity', 'interns1', 'hermes', 'hunyuan', 'gigachat3', 'gemma4'].

--reasoning-parser.help: Specify the parser for reasoning models. Use 'auto' to detect from chat template. Options include: ['apertus2509', 'deepseek-r1', 'deepseek-v3', 'deepseek-v4', 'glm45', 'hunyuan', 'gpt-oss', 'kimi', 'kimi_k2', 'mimo', 'poolside_v1', 'qwen3', 'qwen3-thinking', 'minimax', 'minimax-append-think', 'step3', 'step3p5', 'mistral', 'nemotron_3', 'interns1', 'gemma4', 'cohere_command4'].

--context-length.help:
The model's maximum context length. Defaults to None (will use the value from the model's config.json instead).

Supports standard SI suffixes (k, M, G, T) and IEC suffixes
    (Ki, Mi, Gi, Ti). Suffixes are case-sensitive.

    Decimals are allowed for SI suffixes only.

    Examples:
        '1k' -> 1000      '1M' -> 1000000    '25.6k' -> 25600
        '1Ki' -> 1024     '1Mi' -> 1048576

--mem-fraction-static.help: The fraction of the memory used for static allocation (model weights and KV cache memory pool). Use a smaller value if you see out-of-memory errors.

--max-running-requests.help: The maximum number of running requests.

--attention-backend.help: Choose the kernels for attention layers.

--linear-attn-backend.help: The default kernel backend for linear attention (GDN/KDA). Can be overridden per-mode by --linear-attn-decode-backend and --linear-attn-prefill-backend.

--moe-runner-backend.help: Choose the runner backend for MoE.

--load-format.help: The format of the model weights to load. "auto" will try to load the weights in the safetensors format and fall back to the pytorch bin format if safetensors format is not available. "pt" will load the weights in the pytorch bin format. "safetensors" will load the weights in the safetensors format. "npcache" will load the weights in pytorch format and store a numpy cache to speed up the loading. "dummy" will initialize the weights with random values, which is mainly for profiling."gguf" will load the weights in the gguf format. "bitsandbytes" will load the weights using bitsandbytes quantization."layered" loads weights layer by layer so that one can quantize a layer before loading another to make the peak memory envelope smaller.

--tokenizer-worker-num.help: The worker num of the tokenizer manager.

--cuda-graph-backend-decode.help: Backend for the decode phase. Folds into cuda_graph_config[decode].backend.

--cuda-graph-backend-prefill.help: Backend for the prefill phase. Folds into cuda_graph_config[prefill].backend.

limits: Synthetic pure auth, config merger and argument repr only; no model/server initialization.
